Inspect up to the 8 most recent substantive support requests in #daytona-support, including their visible thread replies. For each, report the requester, timestamp,
    concise problem, latest response, and status as explicitly resolved, explicitly unresolved, or unclear. Include the visible evidence supporting the status and identify up to 3
    requests that appear to need follow-up. Do not infer a resolution that is not stated. Do not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify any Slack content.
